title: Classify LLM Prefill vs Decode as Compute-Bound or Memory-Bound

blocks.text: Compare compute time with weight-transfer time; the larger lower bound names the bottleneck. The task is: Compare ideal prefill and single-step decode dense-layer rooflines, assuming weights read once per batch. Ignore KV traffic and attention FLOPs. Return classifications and time lower bounds.

The inputs are `parameter_count`, `batch`, `prompt_tokens`, `weight_bytes`, `peak_flops`, `bandwidth`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.

What changes in the boundary case

Change one input at the edge of the stated contract and trace where the behavior changes. Use the Trace control to switch between the normal path and this boundary focus. The algorithm does not get permission to invent an unstated fallback.

A useful test changes one condition while holding the remaining inputs fixed. Compare the output shape, state transition, valid edges, selected tokens, or returned status. This isolates the reason for the change.
